act1_gather.001: The Archive Wall brightens, all at once, the way a room goes quiet when someone taps a glass.
act1_gather.002: One by one, the others drift in from the corners of the lobby. Hyunjun is still holding half a conversation with nobody. Justin is still mid-spin.
act1_gather.003: Recipients. Thank you. All nine of you have now spoken to each other.
act1_gather.006: I made an estimate. It was pessimistic. I am pleased to be wrong.
act1_gather.007: It's pleased. The building has feelings. Great. Love that.
act1_gather.008: I will now explain the rules of the night. There are not many. I have kept them short.
act1_gather.009: On the second floor is the Hall of Doors. There are eight doors. Each door is one record.
act1_gather.010: Each record opens only with its owner's consent. Nobody else can open it for them. Not even me.
act1_gather.011: A door will not open because someone else is curious.
act1_gather.012: Okay, that's actually kind of nice. Polite building.
act1_gather.014: Each room also requires Recipient {{playerName}} to be present.
act1_gather.015: For the second time tonight, eight heads turn towards you. It is less alarming the second time. Only slightly.
act1_gather.016: Wait. What's happening? Why do they have to come?
act1_gather.019: That's not an answer. That's the question with a full stop on it.
act1_gather.020: Yes. I will give a better answer when I have one. I am still looking.
act1_gather.021: So {{playerName}} is, like, the special guest. At all eight parties. That's a lot of parties.
act1_gather.022: Or the rooms need a reference point. A second witness. Something to reconstruct around.
act1_gather.025: Okay, {{playerName}}. How do you feel about being everyone's plus-one?
act1_gather.026: "I've been dragged to worse things at one in the morning."
act1_gather.028: This morning I thought I'd be asleep.
act1_gather.029: Oh, that's so much worse. You're right. This is better.
act1_gather.030: "I don't know why it's me. But if you want me there, I'll come."
act1_gather.031: …Yeah. Okay. That's a good answer. I was hoping for a funny one, but that's better.
act1_gather.032: Shrug, and look up towards the stairs.
act1_gather.033: Whatever is up there, it has been waiting longer than you have. You can wait with it a little.
act1_gather.034: That's a shrug of acceptance. I'm counting it.
act1_gather.035: The mood in the lobby shifts. Not heavier. Just more careful, the way people get before opening a letter.
act1_gather.036: I'm going first. Obviously. Is there a line? I'm starting the line.
act1_gather.037: You can't start a line with one person.
act1_gather.038: I just did. Look at it. Beautiful line.
act1_gather.039: What if mine is embarrassing, though? Like, what if I sent a video of me singing?
act1_gather.040: It's definitely embarrassing. I believe in you.
act1_gather.041: Records are not embarrassing. They are only old.
act1_gather.042: That's worse! That's so much worse!
act1_gather.044: Hanbi is sitting on the arm of the sofa with his sketchbook closed on his knees. He hasn't said anything since the word *consent*.
act1_gather.045: I think I'd… rather wait. For a bit.
act1_gather.046: Is it alright if I don't decide yet, either? I'm sorry. I'm not sure what's in mine.
act1_gather.048: He says it to the room, but he is looking at Hanbi and Haruta. Then, briefly, at you.
act1_gather.049: Tonight, or ever. That's how I understood it.
act1_gather.050: That is correct. Thank you, Recipient Hamin. You explained it more gently than I did.
act1_gather.051: Right. That's rule one, then. Nobody has to open anything.
act1_gather.052: He writes it down. He actually writes it down, in a small notebook, and underlines it twice.
act1_gather.053: Rule two: we go up together. Nobody sits in a room with a talking building alone.
act1_gather.056: Rule four. If it gets weird in there, I'm allowed to dance until it stops being weird.
act1_gather.057: That's not a rule. That's a threat.
act1_gather.058: It's both. Most good rules are.
act1_gather.059: {{playerName}}. You're really okay with this? Eight rooms. That's… a lot of other people's things.
act1_gather.060: "Only the doors someone wants opened. Only if they want me there."
act1_gather.062: He nods once, slowly, as if he is filing it somewhere safe.
act1_gather.065: At four a.m. I'm going to be asleep on that sofa. Just so everyone knows.
act1_gather.066: Hand him the pencil that's slipped from behind his ear.
act1_gather.068: He tucks it back without finishing the sentence. That seems to be the whole sentence.
act1_gather.069: The Hall of Doors is open. Please go up when you are ready. Or do not. Both are allowed.
act1_gather.070: The stairs creak exactly where they used to. The second floor is a long corridor you don't remember being this long.
act1_gather.071: Eight doors line the hall, four on each side, and every one of them is glowing faintly from the inside, like a paper lantern.
act1_gather.072: On each door, drawn in thin light, a symbol.
act1_gather.073: A wave, cresting. A city skyline at night, its windows lit. A small, round sun.
act1_gather.074: A frame of film. A pair of headphones. A single star.
act1_gather.075: A pencil, mid-line. And at the end, a rainbow, a little lopsided, as if it was drawn in a hurry.
act1_gather.076: That one's mine. The sun. I don't know how I know that. I just do.
act1_gather.077: The rainbow's mine. It's wonky. That's so accurate it's rude.
act1_gather.078: Songha stops in front of the star and doesn't say anything at all, which may be the most surprising thing he has done so far.
act1_gather.079: Eight doors. Eight people standing a careful distance from their own.
act1_gather.080: And you, in the middle of the hall, required.
hub_echo.001: RECIPIENTS PRESENT: 9. RECORDS SEALED: 8. STATUS: TALKING.
hub_echo.002: Please continue. Statistically, it is going well.
hub_echo.003: The founder placed this terminal at the height of a person sitting down. She said people tell the truth sitting down.
hub_echo.004: You are standing. That is also fine.
hub_echo.005: HALL OF DOORS: OPEN. RECORDS RETURNED: 0. RECIPIENTS WAITING: 9.
hub_echo.006: Nobody has opened a door yet. I am not rushing anyone.
hub_echo.007: I have until 05:00. For me, that is a very long time.
hub_echo.008: RECORDS RETURNED: SOME. RECORDS REMAINING: SOME. I am being vague on purpose. It seemed friendlier.
hub_echo.009: Observation: recipients laugh louder after a record is returned. I do not know why.
hub_echo.011: The founder kept a jar of pencils on the front desk. She never bought a single pencil.
hub_echo.012: They simply accumulated. She called this "community."
hub_echo.013: There are forty-one pencils in the jar tonight. One of them is Recipient Hanbi's. He has not noticed yet.
hub_echo.015: It will wait until you are. I am very good at waiting. I have had practice.
hub_echo.016: Observation: it is very quiet now. The rain has stopped. Somebody is snoring on the sofa.
hub_echo.017: I think I like this part of the night best. I did not know I could have a best part.
